purpose: Explain the evolution of the DataTalks FAQ workflow

required_facts.fact: Course cohorts bring repeated questions into Slack.
The Google Docs FAQ reached about 1,300 entries.
Alex Litvinov built a RAG Slack bot.
The bot ingests FAQ, Slack, GitHub and YouTube sources.
The FAQ migrated to Git Markdown files.
A custom Python generator avoided Jekyll and Liquid/Jinja conflicts.
The generator exports JSON as well as HTML.
The automation bot decides NEW, UPDATE or DUPLICATE.
Human review with Claude Code remains in the loop.

author_attribution: Attribute Alex Litvinov's bot and Fred Pearce's GitHub Actions work explicitly.
